lin.name: Flight Console
lin.idea: a 1969 flight console: a readout strip across the top (TODAY, PLANS, TO DO, LATE, IDEAS), the coming weeks drawn as a flight plan of hops between stops, an annunciator of lit lamps on Status, a crew board of lamps on To do, a T-minus countdown for setup, a flight-log chat

changes: bring back the original Phosphor page's light wherever this design shows phosphor: every effect in phosphor_kit.md that fits it, in this design's own terms
the radar and her screen at full strength: the sweep's afterglow, glowing blips, and her glyph screen's bloom and scanlines
the green screens as real tubes again: VT323 at three strengths, a third of a pixel of blur, bloom, scanlines, and the curved glass falling into shadow at its corners
